methods.title: Outcome delegation agreement
methods.job: Transfer a bounded responsibility
methods.evidence: Autonomy-support and work-redesign research informs conditions; no direct test of this agreement. Decision rights, useful support and actual work conditions must change; fewer questions alone is not improvement.

jobs: Transfer a bounded responsibility
preconditions: A willing recipient, authorised decision owner and a specific piece of work.
avoid: You cannot transfer the decision, the recipient lacks time or qualification, or the risk has no assurance/recovery route.

support_gaps.reason: Clarifies a bounded transfer; skill and capacity gaps require support first.

coordination.reason: Agreement needs a legitimate delegator and recipient, not merely a cross-team wish.

profile.output: A written agreement: result, decision rights, support, checkpoint and recovery owner.
profile.outcome: Delivery and decision quality within the boundary, distinguishing appropriate early escalation from avoidable rescue; fewer escalations alone is ambiguous.
profile.guardrail: Watch hidden overtime, rework and loss of necessary assurance. Pause if authority or capacity changes.

metric_contract.immediate_output: A written agreement: result, decision rights, support, checkpoint and recovery owner.

methods.title: GROW coaching
methods.job: Help someone choose their own next step
methods.evidence: A randomized professional-coaching bundle included GROW; broader coaching studies often exclude managers/peers. Neither the acronym alone nor this short manager-led rendition was isolated; chosen goals and evaluative power matter.

jobs: Help someone choose their own next step
preconditions: Consent to a coaching conversation and a goal within their influence.
avoid: Instruction, resources, a formal decision or protection is needed; do not coach someone into accepting overload.

knowledge_state.reason: Coaching helps the person explore their own options; it is not instruction when task knowledge is absent.

voice_conditions.reason: The person must be able to choose and decline; a predetermined directive is not open coaching.

profile.output: A person-owned action and a review agreement, or an explicit decision not to act.

profile.guardrail: Watch pressure to choose the leader’s preferred answer or an impossible commitment. Switch to instruction or a resource decision when needed.

coordination.reason: A private bounded conversation usually avoids unnecessary exposure; group learning is a different job.

methods.title: Interest-based negotiation
methods.job: Resolve incompatible demands
methods.evidence: Conflict synthesis, conceptual negotiation readings and a publisher book excerpt clarify tradeoffs. Task conflict is not beneficial on average; these are not tests of this negotiation sequence.

preconditions: Named decision owners, negotiable boundaries, relevant affected-party input and a realistic alternative if no agreement is reached.
avoid: Safety or rights are being bargained away, participation is coerced, the user cannot authorise a commitment, or alleged misconduct needs an independent formal route.

alignment.reason: Compare legitimate interests and realistic alternatives; disputed facts may require inquiry first.

voice_conditions.reason: Consent and bargaining power matter; negotiation cannot waive protections.

profile.output: An explicit disposition with rationale and responsibilities. A reasoned no-agreement outcome can be useful.
profile.outcome: At the agreed checkpoint, have the accepted commitments protected the named interests within their constraints? If no agreement, review whether the stated alternative remains feasible. Baseline, observer, period and review date are locally agreed.

reversibility.reason: A live test needs an evidenced acceptable recovery boundary, not just a small sample.

knowledge_state.reason: Teaching requires a suitable known procedure and qualified instructor, not an invented solution.

methods.title: Fishbone causal-hypothesis map
methods.job: Organise and investigate possible contributors
methods.evidence: General research-methods explanation supports discriminating rival hypotheses. No direct fishbone efficacy evidence was added; group agreement does not identify a cause.

jobs: Organise and investigate possible contributors
preconditions: A specific observable recurring effect, relevant work knowledge and a way to verify hypotheses.
avoid: The largest fishbone branch is called the proven root cause because it received the most discussion.

knowledge_state.reason: Organises alternative explanations; verification can require observation, expertise or a bounded test.

alignment.reason: Separates causal hypotheses from competing accounts instead of voting on truth.

profile.output: A structured set of causal hypotheses and an investigation plan. A debrief examines an episode; a fishbone organizes alternative explanations for an effect, including recurring patterns.
profile.outcome: At the review, record which important explanations were supported, contradicted or remain unknown, and what decision this changes.
profile.guardrail: No labeling people as root causes or substituting brainstorming for a qualified serious-harm investigation.

methods.title: Current-state process map

preconditions: A bounded start/end, access to appropriate non-sensitive examples and participation from people who do the work.
avoid: A leader copies the official procedure and calls it verified without asking the people performing it.

coordination.reason: End-to-end transitions reveal where separate roles interact.

knowledge_state.reason: Observation establishes the current sequence before proposing improvements.

methods.title: Force-field change diagnosis

methods.evidence: Review of change reactions supports separating actual conditions from deficit labels. No causal validation of force-field scores or universal change stages was established.

jobs: Identify present enablers and constraints to change
preconditions: A specific proposed change and affected perspectives; no assumption that the proposal must proceed.
avoid: The sponsor treats high supporting-force scores as permission to override serious objections.

alignment.reason: Present enablers and constraints may include different interests; factual claims still need checking.

support_gaps.reason: Targets conditions that can be changed instead of treating resistance as a trait.

profile.output: A change-readiness diagnosis and targeted enabling actions. Unlike a premortem, it examines forces operating now; unlike interest negotiation, it covers systemic constraints as well as stakeholder concerns.
profile.outcome: At review, check whether the selected barrier/enabler actually changed and whether the change became more feasible.
profile.guardrail: No sums predicting success, labeling people as enemies, or pressure to suppress legitimate objections.

methods.title: If–then implementation plan
methods.job: Link a chosen action to a predictable cue
methods.evidence: Large experimental synthesis supports contingent plans with heterogeneous, bias-sensitive effects. Effect estimates depend on correction method; workplace transfer and component moderators are uncertain.

jobs: Link a chosen action to a predictable cue
preconditions: A genuinely chosen goal, feasible action and observable cue under the person's control.
avoid: A person is told to use willpower cues to meet work that cannot fit their available time.

knowledge_state.reason: Precommits a known useful response; uncertain work may need a learning strategy instead.

support_gaps.reason: Bridges intention and action but cannot supply competence, time or tools.

profile.output: A specific cue–action commitment and a review trigger. Goal setting chooses the destination; implementation intentions pre-decide a response at the moment action is needed.
profile.outcome: Observe the chosen response across eligible cue occurrences and its downstream usefulness, separating absent cues from blocked responses.
profile.guardrail: No rigid automatic response to a changing or unsafe context; stop if the goal is unwanted or resources are missing.

methods.title: Assumption map
methods.job: Prioritise consequential uncertainty before testing
methods.evidence: Research design and PDSA principles support decision-relevant tests. No direct efficacy test of an assumption-map workshop was established.

jobs: Prioritise consequential uncertainty before testing
preconditions: An initiative with explicit assumptions, evidence to inspect and authority to prepare tests without committing them.
avoid: A team chooses the easiest experiment while leaving its critical resource assumption unexamined.

knowledge_state.reason: Chooses what needs learning before a test cycle; does not itself establish the answers.

reversibility.reason: A map can precede any commitment, but proposed live tests must have an acceptable bounded recovery path.

profile.output: A ranked uncertainty register and a test brief. Assumption mapping chooses what must be learned; PDSA supplies an iterative testing cycle. Neither a premortem nor a fishbone performs this importance-versus-evidence prioritization.
profile.outcome: After the next evidence step, record which critical assumption changed status and how that changes the decision.
profile.guardrail: No confidence-as-evidence, fake numerical precision or live exposure to unbounded harm.

methods.evidence: Systematic review and critical monograph examine exemplar selection, explanation and transfer. Excellence can reflect case mix or resources; discovery does not demonstrate a transferable cause.

preconditions: A persistent problem, credible outcome differences, comparable resources and participant-led inquiry.
avoid: A high-output team quietly uses extra staff, making it an invalid resource-comparable exemplar.

knowledge_state.reason: Observed exceptions suggest practices to examine and test, not guaranteed transferable causes.

coordination.reason: Affected people discover and adapt a local practice; individual imitation alone misses context.

profile.outcome: Check implementation, outcomes and burden under receiving-team conditions, retaining comparator and case-mix limits.
profile.guardrail: No cherry-picked stars, hidden subsidies, unsafe shortcuts or assumption that association proves mechanism.

preconditions: A non-emergency brief with enough discretion to examine the intended outcome and affected users.

knowledge_state.reason: Finds what is known about the difficulty and what needs learning.

profile.output: A bounded problem brief with affected users, evidence, success measure, constraints, and next learning question. A perspective check challenges one interpretation; problem framing establishes what work should be attempted before selecting a method or solution.
profile.outcome: At the decision checkpoint, can the owner explain the problem, evidence, boundaries and why the next investment or stop is justified?
profile.guardrail: No endless discovery, assumed user needs or delay of required protective action.

methods.title: Troika peer consultation

methods.evidence: Coaching synthesis explicitly excludes peers; a scholarly comparison helps distinguish helping roles. No direct Troika trial was established; peer agreement does not prove advice or substitute for expertise.

jobs: Use rotating peer perspectives for owner-chosen action
preconditions: Three willing participants, a shareable challenge, accessible participation and truthful privacy limits.
avoid: A manager requires an employee to recount a confidential personnel allegation to peers.

coordination.reason: Uses three-person rotating consultation rather than a collective group decision.

voice_conditions.reason: Voluntary bounded disclosure and ability to decline advice are essential.

profile.output: Three owner-chosen next actions and new perspectives. Unlike GROW, this is a rotating peer-consultation format; unlike 1-2-4-All, it does not build one collective answer.
profile.outcome: At the next agreed check, did each owner attempt a chosen useful step and what changed or remained uncertain?
profile.guardrail: No compelled disclosure, unqualified advice on specialist decisions or pressure to accept peer suggestions.

knowledge_state.reason: Coordinates development objectives and demonstrated learning across experiences.

support_gaps.reason: Development requires opportunities and protected support; do not assume time/access are available.

methods.evidence: Framing and research-design knowledge complements NASA decision guidance. No comparative validation of this scoring/review template; natural-unit criteria and explicit values remain judgments.

preconditions: a bounded decision, legitimate owner, materially different alternatives, evidence or explicit uncertainty, and enough time for analysis. Avoid elaborate analysis for trivial choices; unresolved criteria call for framing rather than invented weights.
avoid: a weighted score cannot compensate for violating a safety requirement.

knowledge_state.reason: Compare decision-specific evidence and uncertainty; preserve incomparable tradeoffs.

consequence.reason: A proportionate review helps meaningful decisions; trivial choices may not warrant it, severe cases need qualified process.

profile.outcome: At the agreed trigger, review whether decisive assumptions and expected consequences held; distinguish new evidence from hindsight.

methods.title: Structured listening interview
methods.job: Understand and correct another person's account
methods.evidence: Perceived-listening synthesis and perspective-getting research inform receiving an account. Predominantly observational listening associations do not prove this script improves performance.

preconditions: uncertainty about events or concerns, a willing participant, appropriate privacy, and capacity to listen without promising a predetermined outcome. Avoid delaying immediate protection or conducting an unauthorized investigation.
avoid: “Listening” to a team after deciding every detail, while implying influence, misrepresents the process.

alignment.reason: Gather an actual account before selecting a solution or assuming agreement.

voice_conditions.reason: Use appropriate private/adapted routes; a listening exercise must not expose people or replace independent protection.

profile.outcome: Check material corrections enter the later account/decision, separately from feeling heard, agreement and independent corroboration.
profile.guardrail: Avoid repeated extraction of sensitive stories, performative listening, unauthorised investigation and delayed protection.

methods.title: Accountable repair after one's own mistake
methods.job: Acknowledge an established mistake and fulfil repair commitments
methods.evidence: Scenario experiments examine perceived apology effectiveness, including null contrasts. Ratings of wording do not establish restored trust, fulfillment or forgiveness.

jobs: Acknowledge an established mistake and fulfil repair commitments
preconditions: a known action/omission one can honestly own, a suitable channel, and willingness/resources to change. Do not coach someone to confess disputed allegations, negotiate away reporting rights, or bypass formal accountability.
avoid: apologizing repeatedly while retaining the same harmful practice is not repair.

alignment.reason: Own an established contribution; do not turn disputed allegations into an unsupported confession.

voice_conditions.reason: Respect the affected person's channel, space and reporting rights; never demand forgiveness.

profile.output: A truthful acknowledgement of established responsibility plus feasible repair and prevention commitments.
profile.outcome: Check fulfilled corrective commitments and recurrence, without pressure for forgiveness or engagement.
profile.guardrail: No pressure to forgive, invented admission, performative apology, exposure or displacement of formal accountability.
